title: What Gratitude Journaling Is and Why It Matters
summary: The foundations of gratitude journaling: what it is and why getting it right pays off.
body:
Gratitude journaling: write 3-5 specific things you're grateful for daily. Research links it to better sleep, mood, and resilience. Specific beats generic - 'my sister's soup' beats 'family.'

Why it matters: 3-5 items daily is the research-backed dose Specific entries work better than generic ones

title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Gratitude Journaling
summary: Start gratitude journaling this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. Pick a notebook or app
2. Set a daily time anchor (coffee, bedtime)
3. Write 3-5 specific gratitudes
4. Add one sentence of 'why' each
5. Weekly: reread and notice patterns

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.
facts: Set a daily time anchor (coffee, bedtime)

title: Gratitude Journaling Beginner FAQ
summary: Straight answers to the most common gratitude journaling questions.
body:
Q: What if I can't think of anything?
A: Start tiny: warm socks, hot coffee, a text from a friend.

Q: Morning or night?
A: Night aids sleep; morning sets tone. Either works.

Q: Digital or paper?
A: Paper slows you down - that's the point.
